events.title: Queensland Ballet: Hamlet
events.location: Talbot Theatre, Thomas Dixon Centre, West End
events.source: The Urban List / Must Do Brisbane
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents a visceral retelling of Shakespeare's Hamlet, fusing classical ballet with powerful storytelling and sweeping music, exploring themes of love, power, and corruption.

events.title: Open Season: Against The Grain Festival
events.description: Part of Brisbane's defining winter cultural program, Open Season, this festival at The Princess Theatre showcases local, national, and international artists across music and art in an exploratory atmosphere.

events.title: Australian Sake Festival Brisbane
events.location: John Reid Pavilion, Brisbane Showgrounds, Bowen Hills
events.description: Sample over 100 sakes, enjoy Japanese food, and experience traditional culture with live taiko drumming and dance performances, plus free Sake 101 seminars.

events.title: Yoga Day Festival Brisbane 2026
events.description: A community-oriented celebration on International Yoga Day, bringing together the local yoga and movement community at The Mantra Room.

events.title: Ubuntu Social
events.description: Brisbane Powerhouse hosts a free, all-ages outdoor celebration of world music, art, and community, designed for curious and open-minded attendees.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: A powerful and thought-provoking exhibition of the world's best photojournalism, offering visual storytelling on global affairs and documentary photography.

events.title: 65th Brisbane Pride Queens Ball Awards
events.description: A vibrant, community-anchored celebration of Brisbane's LGBTQ+ creative community, featuring drag performances, awards, and an energetic social atmosphere.

events.title: Imminence (Live at Riverstage)
events.description: Swedish rock band Imminence delivers an emotionally intense live experience with their cinematic sound, blending post-hardcore and melodic rock.

events.title: An Evening of German Classics | Liederfest Prize Winners Concert 2026
events.description: An intimate recital concert showcasing the winners of Brisbane's classical Liederfest competition, featuring high-quality German art songs.

events.title: Sister Act — Savoyards Musical Theatre Brisbane
events.description: Savoyards Musical Theatre presents the Queensland Community Theatre premiere of the beloved musical Sister Act, offering an authentic local performance experience.

events.title: Samford & Hinterland Arts Trail 2026
events.description: A self-guided arts trail through Samford Valley and the hinterland, inviting creative explorers to visit open studios, galleries, and meet local makers.

events.title: Open Season 2026 (Ongoing Program)
events.location: Various venues (The Tivoli, Princess Theatre, Fish Lane, Glasshouse Theatre, etc.), Brisbane
events.description: Brisbane's defining winter cultural program, Open Season, features over 100 local, national, and international artists across music, art, and performance at various iconic venues throughout the city.

events.title: Live Jazz at Brisbane Jazz Club
events.description: Experience intimate live jazz sessions at the beloved Brisbane Jazz Club, offering an authentic and conversation-friendly atmosphere for music lovers.

events.title: Writing Event at Queensland Writers Centre
events.location: Queensland Writers Centre (State Library precinct), South Bank
events.description: Join a creative community event or workshop at the Queensland Writers Centre, offering opportunities to connect with other writers and engage with literary topics.

events.title: Dine BNE City 2026
events.description: A month-long program of exclusive dining offers and special events across Brisbane City, perfect for exploring the culinary scene and meeting new people in a relaxed social setting.
